body:
v0.15.0 adds GhanaAHIES coverage, survey identity/unit/quantity corrections, multi-catalog wave provenance, reader and native Windows portability, and improved label, scale, grain and panel diagnostics. All 23 reviewed implementation PRs are landed. [Release notes](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/development/docs/releases/v0.15.0.md) describe the full change since v0.14.0, including September work and retained scientific limitations.

Final implementation validation is pinned to `3914d8804d7b2936d75041cea98bbc9ddb6d4c9f`. The final documentation/evidence checkpoint `2e41feda313c28b069259dfbce167e7aacaabada` changes no runtime, test, dependency or build input; the country CONTENTS additions are prose. Merge this development-to-master PR with a **merge commit**, preserving ancestry.

- [x] Final credentialed CI [38746123119](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/actions/runs/38746123119): **4,927 passed, 2,768 skipped, four expected failures and one existing non-strict unexpected pass; zero failures**. All three formerly failed Uganda nodes executed and passed. Unit: 3,293 passed/4,407 skipped. Windows smoke: 327 passed/one skipped. [Exact CI evidence](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/development/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/final-ci/REPORT.md).
- [x] Installed native Windows cold builds on the same source match expected shocks/assets digests: 14,457 and 116,808 rows, eight waves each. Actual Linux Makefile/API assets replay also preserves exact canonical frames and attributes; five new regressions fail on the former script.
- [x] Uganda #967 received explicit maintainer approval after nutrition before/after review. Only the approved nutrition fixture shape/hash changed; independent local comparison matched all 53 baseline entries. Final focused sentinel/kg/invariance/assets/earnings selection: **158 passed, zero failures or skips**. CI's separate invariance module is 52 passed/one skipped, with nutrition explicitly passing.
- [x] Final ordinary corpus pass: all **549 declarations across 38 countries**, 530 successes and the same 19 documented source/wiring errors. All 1,519 raw-table fingerprints match the reviewed cold corpus; four explained served-result differences remain explicit below. Earlier full local suite passed 4,951 tests, and all 2,580 absent-cache cases received a documented follow-up. [Final corpus evidence](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/development/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/final-cache-validation/REPORT.md).
- [x] Shared-cache promotion independently reviewed and verified: **1,518 files**, 153 new paths, 1,215 replacements with recoverable backups, 150 identical files retained, no deletions. The sole excluded hashless country file is Uganda nutrition; its shared counterpart was already absent. L1 and both private evidence roots are preserved. [Transaction result](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/development/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/cache-promotion/promotion-result.json).
- [x] Complete 39-feature audit and independent review are archived, including known source gaps, five existing tenure-vocabulary failures and bounded prior-audit comparisons. No claim of blanket scientific approval is made. Strict API audit and strict documentation build pass; earlier wheel/sdist, no-Git rebuild and installed-package checks are preserved. The tagged PyPI artifact is verified after publishing.
- [x] Original branch inventory has a final disposition for all 193 ref versions, with no unresolved active branch and no deletions. Reviewed issue reconciliation preserves partial umbrella/scientific/source scopes. The #1003 and #1010 test-isolation fixes and #1005 CI thread controls are merged without relaxing assertions.

Known limitations remain open. #798 reproduces existing warm all-wave date losses in Mali (12,745 valid dates) and Tanzania (5,893); complete raw caches are preserved, and ordinary single-wave calls followed by concatenation are a verified bounded workaround. Liberia changes timestamp precision on reload without changing dates; Mali MonthsSpent numeric scalars become text without changing numeric values, missingness or keys. The separate duration-proxy scientific caveat is retained. GhanaLSS Feature assembly still loses 13,472 null-key rows (#1008); geography gaps remain #140/#1009. Uganda's coupled FCT/nutrition writes can remove sibling metadata (#788/#809), so promotion is not a permanent cache-policy repair. #962 and historical #941 attribution remain open. [Workplan and dispositions](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/development/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/WORKPLAN.org).

After this merge, run the actual release target, create the annotated v0.15.0 tag, publish the GitHub Release, and verify Trusted Publishing, wheel/sdist versions and a clean installed PyPI release. Those publication actions are not represented as completed by this PR.
